title: Q10
description:
Read: Gen 43:8-9, Gen 44:30-34, Jer 31:31-34

A man becomes surety for the boy and offers himself in the boy's place, to bear the blame forever. The other text is a covenant with the law written inside and sins not remembered.

a) Surety of a better covenant: what is being guaranteed, if surety is a person standing in for a person?
